JOB PURPOSE
Manage and supervise daily Warehouse operations to ensure safe, accurate, efficient and timely execution across Receiving, Put-away, Collecting, Packing, Outbound and Inventory activities. Drive productivity, manpower utilization, inventory accuracy, quality and continuous improvement.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
2.1 Warehouse Operations
- Manage daily Warehouse operations in accordance with operational plans, SOPs and safety requirements.
- Allocate and coordinate manpower based on workload and operational priorities.
- Monitor operational progress, resolve issues and ensure smooth Warehouse operations.
- Ensure inventory and shipments are processed accurately and on time.

2.2 Productivity & Performance
- Monitor manpower utilization, productivity and operational KPIs.
- Analyze performance gaps and identify root causes.
- Reallocate manpower and recommend actions to improve productivity and operational efficiency.

2.3 Quality, Inventory & Safety
- Ensure inventory accuracy in terms of quantity, location and stock condition.
- Investigate operational errors and implement corrective actions.
- Ensure compliance with SOPs, quality standards, safety regulations and 5S requirements.
- Maintain a safe, clean and organized Warehouse environment.

2.4 Continuous Improvement
- Identify operational bottlenecks, waste and improvement opportunities.
- Conduct root cause analysis and implement improvement actions.
- Participate in Lean, Kaizen and Continuous Improvement initiatives.
- Recommend improvements to processes, manpower, layout, equipment and working methods.

2.5 Team Management
- Lead, coach and develop Warehouse Leaders and employees.
- Assign tasks, monitor performance and provide operational guidance.
- Identify skill gaps and coordinate training activities.
- Build a strong team culture based on Ownership, Teamwork, Discipline and Continuous Improvement.

3. KEY KPIs
- Productivity & operational efficiency
- Inventory accuracy
- Quality / operational accuracy
- Manpower utilization
- Safety & 5S
- Continuous improvement
- Team performance","requirements_text":"Requirements:

Candidate Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management or related fields.
- Minimum 3 years of experience in Warehouse Operations / Warehouse Management.
- Good knowledge of Warehouse operations and WMS.
- Experience in manpower, productivity and KPI management.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical and decision-making skills.
- Good leadership, communication and people management skills.
- Experience in Lean / Kaizen / Continuous Improvement is preferred."}
